summary.text: Karilyn Brown is serving her sixth term in the Arkansas House, representing District 67, which includes portions of Pulaski County.

paragraphs.text: She previously served as a Justice of the Peace in Pulaski County.
She graduated magna cum laude from the University of Arkansas at Little Rock with a degree in professional technical writing.
